tasks.likely_cause: The Airflow scheduler detected a task attempt that stopped sending heartbeats.

evidence.text: Task did not emit heartbeat within time limit (2 seconds) and will be terminated. See https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable/core-concepts/tasks.html#task-instance-heartbeat-timeout

tasks.next_check: Check the worker and scheduler logs at the failure timestamp for restarts or resource exhaustion.
tasks.cause_limit: The scheduler detected a missed heartbeat. The evidence does not identify why it stopped.

retrieved_sections.title: Airflow scheduler detected a missed task heartbeat
steps: Locate the affected task instance in the scheduler event.
Correlate the timestamp with worker and infrastructure logs to find why the heartbeat stopped.

reference.title: Apache Airflow 3.4.0 — Task Instance Heartbeat Timeout
reference.summary: Airflow monitors task instance heartbeats and can fail or retry an attempt when its heartbeat stops.
